content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-62. - Administration; rules and regulations.

           …

faqs.a:
The administration of this article is vested in and shall be exercised by the finance
               director who shall prescribe forms and reasonable rules and regulations in conformity
               with said sections for the making of returns and reports, ascertainment and collection
               of the tax imposed hereunder and for the proper administration and enforcement of
               this article.
(Code 1981, § 31-37; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
